page_title: HOF 3-1 BOC | Hoffenheim v Bochum 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 3 - 1 Goal! Jacob Bruun Larsen slips it to Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 3:1.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Andrej Kramaric.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Oliver Baumann leaps out to thwart his attempt.
89' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
87' Soren Storks interrupts the game. One of the players from Hoffenheim won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A penalty is awarded to Bochum!
84' The referee signals a free kick. Bochum are going to take it from long range.
84' 3:2 – the corner kicks stats.
82' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
81' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' The attendance is 19281.
80' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) replaces Adam Hlozek.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Arthur Chaves will be replaced by Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim).
78' Soren Storks sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
78' Wait! Referee Soren Storks has indicated he is going to review the Bochum goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
77' Peter Zeidler decides to make a substitution. Moritz Broschinski will be replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum).
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Lukas Daschner manages to prod the ball to Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
74' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Bochum.
73' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) but poses no threat.
72' Here is a change. Florian Grillitsch is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
72' A substitution has been made. Alexander Prass is replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
71' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Patrick Drewes (Bochum).
70' Patrick Drewes blocks a long-range effort from Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) towards the left side of the goal. Hoffenheim earn a corner.

69' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Oliver Baumann. This effort really didn't trouble him.
68' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
67' The game is interrupted. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
66' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Felix Passlack.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Tom Bischof plays a long ball to Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the right of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:0.
62' Soren Storks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Felix Passlack (Bochum).
61' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
61' 3:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
59' Bochum are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.

57' Bochum slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
55' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) sees a yellow card from Soren Storks after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
54' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Hoffenheim.
52' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Hoffenheim players look gutted.
52' The Hoffenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Soren Storks makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
50' Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
48' Wonderful movement by Bochum. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' Half-time substitution. Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) is replaced by Lukas Daschner.
46' Peter Zeidler makes a switch. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng is coming on in place of Mats Pannewig (Bochum) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Peter Zeidler gives a chance to Ibrahima Sissoko and Dani de Wit (Bochum) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
44' It looks like Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Soren Storks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

43' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Oliver Baumann guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
41' Bochum work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

41' Bochum are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Bochum show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
34' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
33' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
32' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
32' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Hoffenheim have a corner.
30' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. Hoffenheim win a free kick.
28' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
27' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
27' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Felix Passlack (Bochum). Soren Storks saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar!
23' Hoffenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
21' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is adjudged offside.
18' Half-chance! Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) plays a pass into the box, but Oliver Baumann reacts well to snuff out the attack.
16' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
16' A cross from Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

15' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Hoffenheim are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
14' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:0.
9' Hoffenheim exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
8' The free kick from long range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

4' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Patrick Drewes makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
4' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
2' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bochum will kick-off.
Soren Storks will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
